test_title: PYST 26: SSC CGL 2023 - English (Held On: 24 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is "traded."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **"Traded"** is used to convey the idea that people engaged in the exchange of goods or services before the existence of a formal currency system.
 
• It means to exchange something for something else. (एक वस्‍तु देकर दूसरी वस्‍तु लेना, वस्‍तु-विनिमय करना)
 
• It implies the act of swapping or exchanging items without the use of a standardized medium of exchange like money.
 
• Hence, the answer is option 3.
 
• Correct paragraph: 

In today's world, handling money and making purchases and sales come naturally to us. However, prior to the development of any kind of currency, people **traded**__ in a variety of ways. The barter trade was the simplest of them all. People would trade the things they owned for the things they wanted in this kind of ______ (2) ______................ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Advertised: **to put information in a newspaper, on television, on a picture on the wall, etc. in order to persuade people to buy something, to interest them in a new job, etc. (विज्ञापन करना, देना या लगाना)
 
• **Operated: **to work, or to make something work. (काम करना, परिचालित होना या किसी वस्‍तु को परिचालित करना)
 
• **Marketed: **to sell something with the help of advertising. (विज्ञापन द्वारा माल बेचना)
